Fact: distribution_channels
What to find: Methods of distribution (open weights on repositories, API, cloud platforms, apps).
Card sections that often contain it: Model Sources, Availability, Distribution, Access

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Open weights are published on Hugging Face and ModelScope (GitHub and HF formats). The card says all models and code are publicly released. Deployment is possible via LMDeploy and vLLM.
quotes: All models and code are publicly released.
> In most cases, both [LMDeploy](https://github.com/InternLM/lmdeploy) and [vLLM](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm) can be used for model deployment.
